title: Chọn 'Trắc nghiệm' nhưng học viên thấy ô điền từ (text input)
method: live UI via Playwright MCP + real DB row + real API (no mock data)

real_data.db_row: exercises.exercise_id=777434, lesson_id=91920 ('thầy bình'), exercise_type=MULTIPLE_CHOICE, options=["a","b","c","d"], correct_answer='d', created_at=2026-09-21 22:01:00

scale_measured.correction: An earlier draft of this evidence called 32,814 rows 'placeholder options'. That was WRONG. The correct query shows those rows have options IS NULL; ZERO rows have bare-letter options. Row 777434 (options [a,b,c,d]) is a rare exception, not the majority. The majority (options NULL) was always answered by typing the answer and graded server-side, so the first fix (which removed the text input) was a mass regression 44x the original bug. Corrected after adversarial review.

root_cause.mechanism: parsedOptions() treats options matching the bare-letter pattern as placeholders and returns null; hasOptionChoices() then returns false for a MULTIPLE_CHOICE row, and the template falls through to the <input type=text> branch. For row 777434 the learner therefore saw a different exercise type than the admin selected.
root_cause.create_path_gap: AdminExercises.vue saveExercise() serialized options without validating they carry real answer text, and ExerciseService.createExercise() had no options validation either.

fix.render_path: LessonExerciseTab.vue — hasOptionChoices() keeps letter options as choices (type is never silently changed); when options are missing the text-answer fallback is KEPT (so the 32,814 legacy NULL-option rows stay answerable) with a role=note content warning; rawOptions() filters blanks so no empty option button renders.
fix.create_path_frontend: AdminExercises.vue saveExercise() rejects a new MULTIPLE_CHOICE with fewer than 2 options or all bare letters, with a clear Vietnamese message.
fix.create_path_backend: ExerciseService.assertNewChoiceOptionsUsable() — validates only NEW choice items, or updates that supply options; deliberately never validates the stored shape of legacy NULL-option rows, which would block all their legitimate edits. Throws BadRequestException (HTTP 400).
fix.ai_path: AiExerciseService.validateSchema() now requires at least one option with real content (the local model could emit [a,b,c,d] — distinct and size 4 — which passed every prior check).
fix.first_attempt_regression: Removing the text-input fallback made 32,814 MULTIPLE_CHOICE + 319 LISTENING rows unanswerable (a dead card). Caught by adversarial review; reverted to keeping the text fallback with a content warning.

verdict: FIXED — the reported row now renders as multiple choice; legacy NULL-option rows stay answerable; the AI path can no longer persist the bad shape.
